response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, 1.0 * feature_count / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_totals), margins AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM margins WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Sites with no nonmissing feature count are excluded from the average; the overall feature total is positive.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every site in the sites table, treating sites with no nonmissing feature count as having a total of zero.
alternatives.sql: WITH feature_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), site_totals AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, COALESCE(f.feature_count, 0) AS feature_count FROM sites AS s LEFT JOIN feature_totals AS f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, 1.0 * feature_count / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_totals), margins AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM margins WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;
